MERCATOR.NS.d: Mercator Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in shipping, dredging, oil and gas, and coal businesses. It operates in two segments, Shipping; and Coal Mining, Trading and Logistics. The company is involved in coal mining, procurement, and logistics activities. It owns and operates coal mines in Indonesia; and a mining license in Mozambique. The company also explores for petroleum in two blocks located in Cambay basin, Gujarat in India.

MOIL.NS.d: MOIL Limited engages in the exploration, exploitation, and marketing of various grades of manganese ore and value added products in India. It operates through three segments: Mining, Manufacturing, and Power Generation. The company manufactures and sells various grades of manganese ores, such as high grade ores for the production of ferro manganese; medium grade ores for the production of silico manganese; blast furnace grade ores for producing hot metals; and dioxide for dry battery cells and chemical industries.

NESCO.NS.d: Nesco Limited operates exhibition center and IT park in India. It operates through IT Park, Bombay Exhibition Center, Industrial Capital Goods Division, and Nesco Foods segments. The company is also involved in the operation of convention and exhibition center that provides space for trade fairs, exhibitions, conventions, and conferences.

NHPC.NS.d: NHPC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, generates and sells electricity in India. The company generates electricity through hydro, wind, and solar power stations. It owns and operates 24 power stations with an installed capacity of 7,072 megawatts.

NPST.NS.d: Network People Services Technologies Limited builds payment systems for Indian banks, payment aggregators and merchants. Its products include a UPI Switch linked to NPCI systems for instant transactions, mobile banking and digital wallets, instant credit via UPI, Immediate Payment Service, a banking super app, an AI-based billing platform and API-based credit enabling tools.

OMNI.NS.d: Omnitech Engineering Limited, founded in 2006 and based in Rajkot, makes and supplies engineered components and assemblies worldwide, such as slips, mandrels, couplings, cylinders, shafts, drill bits, flanges and fittings. Its customers include the energy, motion control, oil and gas, power, valve, agriculture, earth moving and hydraulic industries.

PIXTRANS.NS.d: PIX Transmissions Limited is a Mumbai-based maker and seller of belts and mechanical power transmission products, founded in 1981. Its belts include poly-V, timing, banded, automotive, industrial, agricultural and V-belts, complemented by PowerWare pulleys, couplings, tensioners and idlers, and accessories such as service kits and gauges.

PROTEAN.NS.d: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd., based in Mumbai and established in 1995, provides IT-enabled e-governance services in India. It was known as NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Limited until October 2021, and it builds and deploys large-scale technology solutions for individuals, businesses and government.

PULZ.NS.d: Pulz Electronics Ltd. is a company operating within the professional audio industry, specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality audio systems. Their product portfolio primarily consists of speakers and amplifiers, segmented into categories such as CineLine, ProLine, StudioLine, and Home Audio. The company also provides annual maintenance contracts for audio systems and trades in certain amplifier types.

RALLIS.NS.d: Rallis India Limited manufactures and markets agri inputs primarily in India. The company offers crop protection products, including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides; seed treatment chemicals; soil conditioners; and seeds, such as hybrid rice, maize, pearl millet, sunflower, vegetable, cotton, paddy, mustard, wheat, etc.

RAMBHAJO.NS.d: Advit Jewels Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RAMBHAJO and traded in INR. Its country is India.

RGL.NS.d: Renaissance Global Limited designs, manufactures, and sells diamond studded jewelry in India and internationally. The company offers gold jewelry, as well as bangles, pendant sets, and other products. It also engages in the retail and trade of cut and polished diamonds; gems; and furniture and accessories.

RKDL.NS.d: Ravi Kumar Distilleries Limited manufactures and sells Indian made foreign liquors in India. The company provides whisky, brandy, rum, vodka, and gin primarily under the Capricorn, Jean Brothers, Black Berry, 2 Barrels, Green Magic, Chevalier, Once More, and other brands. It also designs and erects liquor plants on turn-key basis; and operates as a consultant for source and supply of liquor, beer, wine, etc. Ravi Kumar Distilleries Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Puducherry, India.

ROLEXRINGS.NS.d: Rolex Rings Limited makes and distributes precision-machined and forged rings and automotive components in India and globally. Its products include transmission parts such as gear blanks, ring gears, shafts and lock nuts, and engine parts such as pulleys and cam lobes.

SCAPDVR.NS.d: Stampede Capital Limited provides securities and currencies broking and trading services through various stock exchanges in India. The company was formerly known as Brilliant Securities Limited and changed its name to Stampede Capital Ltd. in July 2011. Stampede Capital Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

SILGO.NS.d: Silgo Retail Limited engages in the design, manufacture, retail, and wholesale of silver jewelry in India. Its product portfolio includes rings, earrings, pendants, necklaces, bracelets, and bangles. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Jaipur, India.

SRTRANSFIN-ZE.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 8.66% Sr.II represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 8.66% and belonging to Series II of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

TIIL.NS.d: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited engages in drum closures, scaffolding, yarn, fabric, and power businesses in India and internationally. It offers drum closures, including steel plated, stainless steel, and steel lacquer drum closures; nylon and poly propylene plugs; and capseals, canseals, insertion dies, and clamps. The company also provides tubes and scaffolding products, such as techring, techlok, techstage, telescopic steel props, steel planks, access frame, tubes, fittings, and accessories.

USHAMART.NS.d: Usha Martin Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells wires, wire ropes, and strands products in India and internationally. The company offers wire ropes, including oil and offshore, crane, mining, elevator, fishing, and general engineering ropes, as well as ropes for conveyor cords, aerial haulage, and structural systems.

VISHAL.NS.d: Vishal Fabrics Limited engages in dyeing, printing, and processing of fabrics and yarns in India. It offers Denim bottom, Denim shirting, and jegging fabrics for men, women, and kids. The company also exports its products. Vishal Fabrics Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

XCHANGING.NS.d: Xchanging Solutions Limited provides information technology services in India, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Cambridge Solutions Limited and changed its name to Xchanging Solutions Limited in June 2012. Xchanging Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Xchanging Solutions Limited operates as a subsidiary of Xchanging (Mauritius) Limited.
